140f49f9623e66cc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة حياكم الرقمية عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتحسين جودة خدمة العملاء، وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء، وتحليل رضا العملاء لضمان تقديم تجربة متميزة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة في خدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة، وضمان المتابعة المستمرة. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية وكفاءة، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تطوير برامج ومبادرات تهدف إلى تجاوز توقعات واحتياجات المتعاملين من حيث جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، لبناء نموذج متكامل. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نتائج تقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع خطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع وتحديد مؤشرات ومعايير الأداء والجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف وتحليل بيانات رضا العملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل ممتازة، شفهية وكتابية. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع الإدارات المختلفة. التفكير الإبداعي في تطوير برامج ومبادرات خدمة العملاء. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والمهنية في جميع المهام. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل أخصائي خدمة العملاء ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى مستويات رضا العملاء. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مؤسسة حياكم الرقمية.

141f8be1308e0f80.description: About the Role The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) is seeking a Senior Resource Mobilization Specialist to join its team in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. This contract position requires 5-10 years of experience and focuses on providing advanced technical and professional expertise in resource mobilization and partnership development. The role supports the Bank in mobilizing and managing additional resources from sovereign and non-sovereign partners, contributing to the design and implementation of resource mobilization strategies and institutional systems. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the development, periodic review, and implementation of the Bank’s comprehensive resource mobilization strategy and related action plans. Translate resource mobilization priorities into funding propositions and engagement plans for Bank-financed programs, operations, and special initiatives. Develop and assess innovative resource mobilization practices, mechanisms, and products to increase off-balance-sheet, concessional, and grant resources. Engage traditional and non-traditional partners, including official development assistance providers, philanthropists, NGOs, civil society organizations, and the private sector, to identify and advance funding opportunities. Administer and implement resource mobilization arrangements, trust funds, and concessional resources in accordance with approved agreements, policies, and procedures. Operational Planning and Reporting Monitor developments in the financing landscape and analyze opportunities in green, sustainable, social, impact, and results-based financing. Support the design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of systems and tools used to track resource mobilization initiatives, partner engagement, commitments, disbursements, and results. Develop proposed targets, key performance indicators, and analytical reports related to resource mobilization performance for management review. Prepare accurate and timely progress reports, dashboards, briefs, and management updates in compliance with Bank rules and reporting requirements. Identify delivery risks, bottlenecks, and data gaps, recommending practical corrective actions and mitigation measures. Partnership Development and Coordination Develop and maintain productive relationships with donors, development partners, MDBs, IFIs, OIC institutions, and other relevant entities. Coordinate with Regional Hubs, sector and thematic teams, legal, finance, and other functions to originate, structure, and progress resource mobilization and co-financing opportunities. Prepare and coordinate strategic dialogues, partner consultations, missions, workshops, and related follow-up actions with priority partners and donors. Conduct partner mapping, market intelligence, and due diligence analysis to identify new partnership opportunities and diversify the Bank’s funding base. Draft or contribute to concept notes, proposals, partnership frameworks, memoranda of understanding, and funding agreements. Represent the Bank at technical meetings, international events, and development-financing forums as delegated. Knowledge Management and Advisory Support Undertake research and prepare analytical papers, knowledge products, talking points, speeches, presentations, and briefing materials for management on resource mobilization and development financing. Benchmark the Bank’s practices against peer MDBs and IFIs and recommend improvements to policies, processes, tools, and approaches. Capture lessons learned and good practices from resource mobilization initiatives and disseminate them through appropriate institutional knowledge channels. Provide technical guidance and advisory support to colleagues across the Bank on funding instruments, donor requirements, partnership development, and resource mobilization processes. Contribute to internal learning sessions and capacity-building activities that strengthen resource mobilization knowledge and capabilities. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in resource mobilization and partnership development within a financial or development institution context.

1454c3110ddb8aab.description: About the Role TAWANTECH is seeking an AI Quality Assurance Engineer to join their team. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, accuracy, and performance of AI/ML solutions throughout the development lifecycle. The position requires 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Role Overview The AI Quality Assurance Engineer will develop and implement testing strategies for AI models, data pipelines, AI applications, and production deployments. This role ensures that solutions meet business, technical, security, and regulatory requirements, contributing to the overall integrity and performance of AI/ML initiatives. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute comprehensive QA and testing strategies for AI/ML solutions. Validate AI models for accuracy, consistency, robustness, and performance. Design test cases for machine learning models, AI applications, APIs, and data pipelines. Perform data quality, data validation, and data integrity testing. Test AI outputs for accuracy, bias, hallucination, reliability, and consistency where applicable. Conduct regression, integration, functional, performance, and automated testing. Establish quality gates and acceptance criteria for AI model deployment. Monitor model performance and identify model/data drift in production. Collaborate with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Data Engineers, and Business stakeholders. Automate testing processes and integrate QA activities into CI/CD pipelines. Document defects, test results, risks, and remediation activities. Support model governance, auditability, and compliance requirements. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in quality assurance, specifically with a focus on AI/ML solutions. This includes practical experience in developing and implementing testing strategies for complex AI systems. Work Type This is a full-time position, requiring dedicated engagement within the team to achieve project goals and maintain high-quality standards for AI/ML solutions. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be discussed with qualified candidates.

1456427d50584e01.description: About the Role Business Management Company (BMC) is establishing a Unified Service Operation Center (USOC) in Riyadh to support critical telecom network infrastructure and enterprise services. We are seeking an experienced USOC Manager to lead 24/7 operations, ensure SLA performance, and drive continuous improvement within this vital center. This is a full-time position requiring significant leadership experience in telecom operations. Key Responsibilities Lead multidisciplinary teams across monitoring, incident management, assurance, and field maintenance functions. Own Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), escalation procedures, and management reporting. Direct major incident response and service restoration efforts. Govern problem and change management processes, as well as service improvement plans. Coach and develop team members to enhance operational capabilities. At least 7 years of this experience must be in leading large Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), or managed-services teams. ITIL certification is required. The role involves leading 24/7 operations within the Unified Service Operation Center.

1496540917c898b3.description: About DP World and the Role DP World Jeddah is seeking an experienced Supervisor ITV to join its Operations team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of relevant experience. The ITV Supervisor is responsible for leading, controlling, and optimizing all Internal Terminal Vehicle (ITV) operations during assigned shifts, ensuring the safe, efficient, and continuous movement of containers between the quay, yard, and adjacent terminal areas. Role Overview The role involves managing ITV resources, monitoring fleet availability and utilization, maintaining operational performance, and ensuring compliance with operational procedures and HSSE requirements. The ITV Supervisor works closely with Vessel, Yard, and Planning teams to support operational continuity, minimize delays, and contribute to achieving vessel productivity and overall terminal performance targets. Key Responsibilities Lead, supervise, and coordinate all ITV activities during vessel loading and discharge operations, yard transfers, and Internal Terminal Transfers (ITT). Plan and allocate ITV drivers and equipment based on operational priorities and real-time demands. Monitor ITV cycle times, fleet utilization, equipment availability, and operational productivity, implementing corrective actions as needed. Coordinate closely with Vessel Supervisors, Yard Supervisors, Planning, and other operational teams to maintain workflow continuity. Ensure optimal utilization and balanced deployment of the ITV fleet to support operational efficiency and minimize idle time. Monitor driver attendance, deployment, performance, and discipline while addressing operational resource gaps. Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks, delays, and inefficiencies impacting container movements and terminal performance. Coordinate with Engineering and maintenance teams to ensure timely resolution of equipment breakdowns and operational disruptions. Enforce compliance with HSSE policies, traffic management procedures, speed limits, designated routes, and PPE requirements. Conduct shift briefings and toolbox talks to communicate operational priorities, safety risks, and key operational updates. Monitor driving behavior and ensure adherence to safe operating practices and established procedures. Report and escalate accidents, near misses, unsafe conditions, and equipment-related incidents in accordance with company procedures. Evaluate driver performance and identify training and competency gaps, providing feedback for coaching and development. Prepare accurate shift reports covering fleet utilization, productivity, operational challenges, incidents, and equipment availability. Ensure effective shift handovers by communicating pending activities, operational constraints, and critical information to the incoming supervisor. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in container terminal operations. Proven experience in fleet supervision and resource coordination. Ability to contribute to safe and efficient terminal operations. Application Candidates with experience in container terminal operations, fleet supervision, and resource coordination who are ready to contribute to safe and efficient terminal operations are encouraged to apply.

149dc01792745585.description: About 2P Perfect Presentation Since 2004, 2P Perfect Presentation has been a leader in Saudi Arabia's ICT sector, providing integrated technology solutions to accelerate digital transformation and improve operational efficiency for organizations. The company delivers end-to-end solutions through its specialized business units and market expertise, built on a foundation of innovation and service excellence. The Role 2P Perfect Presentation is seeking an experienced Senior Geographic Information System Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing, maintaining, and enhancing mission-critical Enterprise GIS infrastructure, spatial geodatabases, and automated geospatial data processing pipelines. The specialist will serve as a core technical custodian of the organization’s ArcGIS Enterprise ecosystem and Enterprise SQL Geodatabases. Key Responsibilities Enterprise GIS Administration & Infrastructure: Administer, monitor, and optimize multi-tier ArcGIS Enterprise environments (Production, Staging, Development), including Portal for ArcGIS, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Data Store, and Web Adaptors. Manage system availability, performance, scalability, and operational stability, including High Availability (HA) configurations and disaster recovery processes. Implement automated backup and recovery workflows, manage SSL certificates, user identities, and access rights. Monitor server health, service utilization, logs, and caches, and automate routine maintenance activities. Spatial Database Administration: Administer and optimize Enterprise Geodatabases on Microsoft SQL Server. Manage spatial schema modifications, permissions, versioning, and archiving. Perform geodatabase maintenance routines, monitor database performance, and optimize indexes and spatial queries. Maintain data integrity across environments and manage automated geodatabase backups and FGDB exports. Support recovery and restoration activities. Geoprocessing & Automation: Design and develop custom ArcGIS Pro script tools and Python Toolboxes (.pyt). Build and maintain standalone automation scripts using Python 3, ArcPy, ArcGIS API for Python, and SQL scripting. Develop and maintain automated geoprocessing workflows for tasks such as address assignment, spatial validation, topology detection, data posting, vector tile generation, and Portal item lifecycle management. Develop automated ETL and data syndication pipelines for external partners and schedule automated GIS jobs. Data Quality Assurance & Monitoring: Develop automated rule-based data validation scripts to validate primary key integrity, administrative boundary relationships, sequence logic, spatial topology, and duplicate records. Implement automated daily data screening routines and develop alert mechanisms for data anomalies and processing failures. Support continuous GIS data quality and governance improvement. Innovation & Modern GIS: Explore and pilot emerging capabilities within the Esri ecosystem, evaluating new technologies such as AI Assistants in ArcGIS Pro, Agentic Mapping, and AI-enabled ArcGIS Instant Apps. Identify opportunities to improve automation, GIS operations, and spatial intelligence capabilities. Produce and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architecture blueprints, data dictionaries, operational procedures, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Required Experience and Skills 5-10 years of experience in a relevant GIS role. Strong hands-on expertise in ArcGIS Enterprise Administration. Proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server spatial databases. Expertise in Python/ArcPy automation and ArcGIS API for Python. Experience with data quality control, vector tile generation, and data syndication. Knowledge of disaster recovery processes for GIS infrastructure. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

14ae330ace014d5d.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Senior Construction Specialist for a full-time position within the Upstream & Drilling sector in Saudi Arabia. Eram Talent is looking for individuals who can contribute to challenging projects in this sector, working alongside teams in Engineering, Drilling, Exploration, Supply Chain, Project Management, Inspection, Field Compliance, Telecommunications, Instrumentation & Control, and IT Support. Working effectively within a challenging project environment. Qualifications and Requirements Relevant educational qualifications in a related discipline. 14b99b317d346fbf.description: About PSA BDP PSA BDP, a member of the PSA Group, is a leading provider of globally integrated and port-centric supply chain, transportation, and logistics solutions. Headquartered in Philadelphia, PA, the company employs over 5,500 people worldwide and serves more than 5,000 customers, including multinational companies in the chemical, retail & consumer, life sciences & pharmaceuticals, and electric vehicle & industrial sectors. Logistics Service Executive Role PSA BDP is seeking a Logistics Service Executive to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience in logistics and forwarding operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing various aspects of logistics services, ensuring efficient and accurate processing of shipments and customer orders. Key Responsibilities Manage order processing, including customer order plausibility analysis. Handle planning, booking, and transportation orders. Coordinate and follow up on shipments. Process customs documentation for both export and import. Manage documentation, administration, invoicing, and filing. Provide feedback to customers through various channels (mail, phone, EDI) and handle internal and external reporting of shipments. Address operational troubleshooting and report non-conformances in line with KPIs. Cooperate with approved subcontractors according to agreed rates. Ensure end-to-end processing and punctual, flawless order handling and documentation. Process freight audit payments. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 years of detailed experience in logistics and forwarding operations, regulations, and documentation. A professional degree from a licensed educational institution specializing in logistics and forwarding is preferred. Proficiency in Microsoft Software applications and/or other market-leading software applications. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Eastern Region. The role involves working within a team that values diversity and a close-knit community atmosphere, offering opportunities for professional growth within the organization.

14da7e70ef5c8378.description: About the Role MSI Qatar is seeking a Training Specialist (Digital Communication) to join their team. For expat candidates without a degree: A High School Diploma or Vocational School Diploma in Telecommunication is required. Required Experience Candidates with a relevant degree must have a minimum of four (4) years of experience in the Oil & Gas sector. Candidates without a degree must have a minimum of eleven (11) years of experience in the Oil & Gas sector. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position located in the Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia. The role involves working across various cities, including Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al-Ahsa, Al Jubail, Al Qatif, Ras Tannurah, Buqayq, Al Khafji, and Hafar Al Batin. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified qualifications and experience are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

1463530f38cb0a1f.description: About the Role Primark is seeking a Visual Merchandiser to join their team. 1400523acbf8e2f9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التقنيه والخدمات المتطوره عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور مخصص لحديثي التخرج، ولا يتطلب خبرة عملية سابقة، حيث يركز على تحديد المخاطر في بيئة العمل وتطوير برامج للوقاية من الأمراض المهنية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتوفر فرصة ممتازة لبدء مسيرة مهنية في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة بيئة العمل لتحديد المخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية. اقتراح أساليب وإجراءات لتفادي تأثيرات المخاطر على العاملين. تحويل العاملين للفحص الطبي الدوري للتأكد من عدم تأثرهم بأمراض مهنية. قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج في مواقع العمل ومقارنتها بالمستويات المقبولة. التوصية بالإجراءات التصويبية اللازمة لتحسين مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج. مراقبة ومتابعة إجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية السائلة والصلبة لضمان عدم تأثيرها على صحة البيئة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال الصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالصحة المهنية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء تنفيذ مختلف أعمال الصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرة لا يشترط توفر خبرة عملية سابقة (0-1 سنة خبرة). هذه الوظيفة مخصصة لحديثي التخرج. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي الصحة والسلامة المهنية ضمن فريق متخصص في الرياض، في بيئة عمل تلتزم بأعلى معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بالدوام الكامل. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: الرياض. نوع العمل: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن.

140411654810a3c3.description: About the Role ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail is seeking a Specialist Technical Materials Procurement to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern region. This full-time role is responsible for sourcing and procuring Electrical and Instrumentation (E&I) MRO materials essential for plant operations and maintenance. The specialist will serve as the primary procurement contact for various internal departments, ensuring timely and cost-effective material availability while adhering to company policies. Role Responsibilities Manage the procurement of Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) MRO materials to support operational and business requirements. Develop and execute sourcing strategies, increase contract coverage, and manage long-term agreements to ensure cost-effective and reliable supply. Conduct RFQs, commercial evaluations, negotiations, supplier selection, and contract administration in compliance with company policies. Collaborate with end-users and stakeholders to understand requirements and provide effective procurement solutions. Expedite purchase orders and shipments, monitor delivery performance, and provide timely status updates to stakeholders. Coordinate with suppliers, logistics, warehouse, finance, and end-users to resolve supply, delivery, invoicing, and payment-related issues. Support procurement data quality and PO cleansing activities to ensure accurate records and reporting. Follow up on supplier invoices and work closely with Finance to facilitate timely payment processing. Monitor supplier performance and drive continuous improvement in quality, service, and delivery. Identify and implement cost-saving, standardization, inventory optimization, and value improvement initiatives. Expand the supplier base, promote local content opportunities, and develop alternative sourcing channels to enhance competition and supply resilience. Reduce supply dependency risks through multi-sourcing strategies and supplier development initiatives for critical materials. Monitor market trends, supplier capabilities, and supply risks, implementing mitigation plans where required. Provide procurement support for other material categories and special assignments as needed to meet departmental objectives. Ensure compliance with procurement governance, ethical standards, company policies, and regulatory requirements. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in technical materials procurement, preferably within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Experience with Electrical and Instrumentation (E&I) MRO materials is highly valued. Key Contributions This role is critical in developing category sourcing strategies, establishing long-term agreements, managing supplier relationships, and expediting critical purchase orders. The specialist will provide regular status updates to end-users and coordinate with various stakeholders to ensure on-time delivery and support business continuity. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, operating within a dynamic environment that requires close collaboration with warehouse, maintenance, planning, and other plant end-users, as well as external suppliers and logistics providers.

1430b178f91c73ae.description: تعلن شركة بوخمسين الصناعية عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى محاسب (Accountant) للانضمام إلى فريق العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الوظيفية أولًا: المحاسبة العامة والتقارير المالية تسجيل ومراجعة القيود اليومية والتأكد من دقتها واكتمال المستندات الداعمة. متابعة الحسابات العامة وإعداد التسويات المحاسبية الدورية. إعداد ميزان المراجعة والتقارير المالية الشهرية والربع سنوية والسنوية. المشاركة في أعمال الإقفال المحاسبي الشهري والربع سنوي والسنوي. تنظيم وأرشفة المستندات والفواتير والسجلات المحاسبية. ثانيًا: حسابات الموردين والعملاء طلب ومراجعة كشوف حسابات الموردين (SOA) بشكل دوري ومطابقتها مع سجلات الشركة. متابعة الفواتير الناقصة والتأكد من استلام وتسجيل جميع فواتير الموردين. إعداد تسويات حسابات الموردين ومعالجة الفروقات المحاسبية. متابعة أرصدة العملاء والمستحقات المالية والفواتير غير المسددة. إصدار ومراجعة فواتير العملاء والمستخلصات المالية وفق العقود والأعمال المنجزة. متابعة التحصيلات وتحديث تقارير أعمار الديون (Aging Reports). متابعة الدفعات المقدمة والدفعات المستحقة للموردين وربطها بأوامر الشراء والفواتير. ثالثًا: الضرائب والالتزام المالي إعداد ومراجعة إقرارات ضريبة القيمة المضافة (VAT) بشكل ربع سنوي. التأكد من تسجيل جميع فواتير المشتريات والمبيعات ضمن الفترات الضريبية الصحيحة. مراجعة الفترات الضريبية السابقة ومعالجة أي فروقات أو مستندات ناقصة. الالتزام بمتطلبات هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك (ZATCA) والفوترة الإلكترونية. رابعًا: الحسابات البنكية والمدفوعات إعداد التسويات البنكية ومطابقة الحركات مع السجلات المحاسبية. متابعة التحويلات البنكية المحلية والدولية وتسجيلها محاسبيًا. إعداد جداول المدفوعات المستحقة للموردين ومتابعة تنفيذها بعد الاعتماد. متابعة الشيكات والضمانات البنكية وسندات الأمر والالتزامات المالية. إعداد تقارير التدفقات النقدية والالتزامات والمدفوعات المتوقعة. خامسًا: محاسبة المشاريع والعقود متابعة الحسابات المالية للمشاريع ومطابقتها مع العقود وأوامر الشراء. مراجعة المستخلصات والدفعات المقدمة ونسب الاستقطاع (Retention). متابعة استرداد الضمانات والمبالغ المحتجزة والمستحقات النهائية للمشاريع. إعداد تقارير مالية توضح مستحقات كل مشروع والمدفوعات والتحصيلات. التنسيق مع أقسام المشاريع والمبيعات والمشتريات لضمان صحة البيانات المالية. سادسًا: المتابعة والتنسيق إعداد تقارير دورية للإدارة عن أرصدة الموردين والعملاء والمستحقات. متابعة المعاملات المالية المفتوحة والتأكد من إغلاقها في الوقت المحدد. التنسيق مع الموردين والعملاء والأقسام الداخلية لاستكمال المستندات والتسويات. دعم أعمال التدقيق الداخلي والخارجي وتوفير المستندات المطلوبة. المؤهلات والمتطلبات بكالوريوس في المحاسبة أو المالية. خبرة عملية في المحاسبة، ويفضل في الشركات الصناعية أو المقاولات. معرفة جيدة بالأنظمة المحاسبية والضريبية في المملكة العربية السعودية. إجادة استخدام Microsoft Excel والبرامج المحاسبية. إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية في المراسلات والتعامل مع الموردين. القدرة على إدارة عدة حسابات ومهام في الوقت نفسه. الدقة في العمل والقدرة على
